correctness.rationale: For any forest, integrate leaf positions to prove joint independence of edge indicators; only identical edges and triangles contribute to the third cumulant. Cyclic Dirichlet gaps give T(r)=3r²+(3r-1)_+², and dense-branch sign is the strictly monotone polynomial -1+3q+2(n-3)q². Kernel Fourier coefficients sin(2πkr)/(πk), finite-dimensional complex CLT, and uniform L² truncation yield the independent exponential series. Third cumulant delta(r)>0 excludes a Gaussian limit. 993 finite checker tests passed; infinite claims rely on analysis.

value.rationale: Pairwise independence makes the first two edge-count moments exactly binomial, but a triangle cumulant produces a natural first detectable geometric deviation at third order. The exact r_n transition classifies the skewness sign at every radius and size. For n>3, a whole dense interval has geometric positive skewness despite the matching independent-edge null being negatively skewed. The explicit non-Gaussian fixed-radius limit explains why the geometry signal persists asymptotically. This is a natural model-comparison invariant, not an arbitrary finite enumeration.
